meta.description: Run a complete computational drug discovery pipeline using NVIDIA BioNeMo NIMs: generate drug-like molecules with GenMol, dock them to a protein target with DiffDock, then predict binding affinity with Boltz2. Use for drug discovery pipeline, hit discovery, lead optimization, virtual screening combining molecule generation, docking, and affinity prediction.

key_strengths: Complete end-to-end drug discovery workflow composing three complementary NIMs (GenMol, DiffDock, Boltz2)
Clear sequential structure with data flow from molecule generation through docking to affinity prediction
Prominent security warning about data transmission to external APIs in skill description
Comprehensive result interpretation guidance covering QED, docking confidence, pIC50, and binding probability
Both de novo and scaffold-based generation patterns documented with examples

recommendations.title: Add error handling for empty GenMol results
recommendations.problem: Code does not check if molecules list is empty before slicing top_20, causing IndexError if generation yields zero valid molecules
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes GenMol always returns sufficient valid molecules; no guard for low-yield scenarios
recommendations.fix: After molecules_sorted = sorted(...), add: if len(molecules_sorted) < 20: print(f'Warning: only {len(molecules_sorted)} valid molecules generated'); top_20 = molecules_sorted. Document fallback strategy in 'Before you start' section.

recommendations.title: Refactor into progressive disclosure structure
recommendations.problem: All content in monolithic 220-line SKILL.md; no reference files for per-NIM parameter details, endpoint schemas, or troubleshooting
recommendations.root_cause: Single-file approach acceptable for simple skills but inefficient for complex multi-NIM pipeline
recommendations.fix: Create references/ directory with genmol_reference.md, diffdock_reference.md, boltz2_reference.md for detailed per-service documentation; reduce SKILL.md to high-level workflow and integration points.

recommendations.title: Add modular execution guidance
recommendations.problem: No instructions for running individual pipeline steps independently; user wanting only molecule generation must extract code manually
recommendations.root_cause: Skill optimized for full pipeline execution; single-step use cases not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add section 'Running Individual Steps': 'For single-step tasks, use the individual skills: genmol-nim for molecule generation only, diffdock-nim for docking only, boltz2-nim for affinity prediction only. This skill is for full pipeline execution.'

recommendations.title: Add escape hatch for partial pipeline failures
recommendations.problem: No guidance on recovering from mid-pipeline failures (e.g., all docking jobs fail, Boltz2 timeout)
recommendations.root_cause: Happy-path focus; intermediate failure scenarios not documented
recommendations.fix: Add 'Troubleshooting' section: document strategies for GenMol low-yield (increase num_molecules), DiffDock batch failures (retry with simplified parameters), Boltz2 long-sequence timeouts (split into shorter fragments or fall back to docking confidence ranking only).
